assessment: The exact actual user-home prefix occurs in 56 JSON string values across five tracked raw blobs. All 56 values begin with that prefix; all examined structural pointers name local paths or path-bearing fields. None of those fields contains the inspected regex markers. No direct gzip decoded view added an occurrence. This is not a recursive archive clearance.
field_locations: raw-json-classification.json; queue and ledger subset additionally in json-pointers.json. Values are withheld and only their digests retained.
dependencies: dependency-inventory.json records 528 tracked literal-reference files, 186 verifier-name candidates, direct CP20–29 queue/ledger hash and length assertions, inspected CP16–19 link relationships, and verify_recovered.py exact-object assertions. A literal reference alone is not proof that a verifier requires exact bytes. Compressed references and dynamically constructed paths require further analysis.
proposal: Preserve the exact original objects in controlled local custody with their original SHA-256, Git blob, revision, source, and receipt attribution. Publish separately named reconstructed JSON in which the entire 56 local path values are replaced by explicit redaction markers, preserving all other fields where possible. Record original and public byte lengths, digests, per-field JSON pointers and value digests, transformation policy, and verification limitations. Do not label reconstructed bytes as the original Git blob. Keep historical indices as original identity claims, and add explicit original-to-public mappings and privacy-aware validators for current public bytes; old exact-original verifiers require private originals or qualified replacement verifiers. Reinspect remaining account/temp paths and archives before claiming a public copy is safe.
history_qualification: A later commit removing private values from its tree does not erase the already published historical commit or guarantee its unavailability. History rewriting is outside this task and was not performed.
limits: This pass examines exact local account-home prefix, raw tracked blobs and one direct gzip decoding layer (max 128 MiB each); it does not attribute tar members, expand nested compressed data, cover other accounts/temp roots or unknown encodings, or prove absence of secrets. The separately running recursive scan remains incomplete. No product code, tests, builds, probes, source changes, cleanup or publication mutation.
